constraint-music.additional_constraints: Own default tonal progression, ranges, cadence and voice leading; quarter notes.
constraint-music.context_origin: Public GenerationSpec fields and native writer.

music21.additional_constraints: Root-position I-IV-V-I figured bass; whole notes; deterministic first realization.
music21.context_origin: Key/meter arguments; observed default tempo 120, not a tempo generation argument.

diatony.generation_evidence: two new C/G development generations with original native MIDI retained
diatony.additional_constraints: Root-position I-IV-V-I; four whole notes; one worker, 2000 ms search cap.
diatony.context_origin: External request supplied to benchmark renderer; mode/length from pinned native capture profile.

midi_equivalences: Positive PPQN scaling with exact rational musical times; track 1..4/channel 0..3 declare S/A/T/B for adapted Diatony.
eligibility: Only requests exactly matching requests/C.json or requests/G.json. Unknown fields and unsupported features are rejected, never dropped.
generation_mapping_limit: Shared envelope does not make system-native search spaces equal. No fixed harmony or given voice is requested; these remain unsupported across all public interfaces. Existing CM/music21 inputs are mapped retrospectively, not rerun as paired attempts.
